an8.59:1.1: [sāvatthinidānaṃ] aṭṭhime bhikkhave, puggalā āhuneyyā pāhuneyyā dakkhiṇeyyā añjalikaraṇīyā anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassa.
an8.59:1.3: sotāpanno sotāpattiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno, sakadāgāmī sakadāgāmiphala sacchikiriyāya paṭipanno, anāgāmī anāgāmiphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno, arahā arahattaphalasacchikiriyāya paṭipanno.
an8.59:1.4: ime kho bhikkhave, aṭṭhapuggalā āhuneyyā …pe… anuttaraṃ puññakkhettaṃ lokassāti.
